notes: Wikiquote's Flashdance page returned a Wikimedia Error on every try (four tries, 20 second waits), so no quote could be checked; the note is kind note, unquoted, in Alex's voice, and its claims (mill shift, dancing at night) match Wikipedia, so it is ok. Mawby's, Richie the cook and stand-up, Jeanie the figure skater, Grunt, Hanna Long, breakdancers, the Conservatory of Dance and Repertory on Wikipedia. Lobster dinner and Tina's 'He didn't call' / 'He called' on TV Tropes. Tab sums check: 33.50 + 14.00 = 47.50.

vibe.verdict: Mawby's bar tab is the right room, but the food is generic Pittsburgh bar food, the lines are plain, and the poster plus a Flashdance logo strip take the front with little of the film's drama.
